mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month average.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production below 100 signals manufacturing slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 100 and the economy is in late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls relative to its 12-month moving average signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS exceeds its 12-month average.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the CPI index above 300 signals high inflation, prompting central bank tightening that compresses equity multiples and generates negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 300.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1300 units signals weakening residential construction, reducing consumer confidence and equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST falls below 1300.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and GDP growth rate signals economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both INDPRO and GDPC1 decline.
